title: Azure Networking Services
description: Master Azure virtual networks, subnets, NSGs, load balancers, application gateways, VPN gateways, and CDN.
longDescription: This module covers Azure's core networking services: virtual networks and subnets for isolation, network security groups for traffic filtering, load balancers and application gateways for distribution and routing, VPN gateways and ExpressRoute for hybrid connectivity, and Azure CDN for global content delivery.
whatYouLearn: Design virtual networks with subnets and IP addressing
Filter traffic with network security groups and application security groups
Choose between load balancers and application gateways
Set up hybrid connectivity with VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute
Accelerate content delivery with Azure CDN
